title: Assured
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 37.25 Linked Discourses 37.25
  • 3. Balavagga 3. Powers

Visāradasutta Assured

“Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa balāni. “Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady. Katamāni pañca? What five? Rūpabalaṁ, bhogabalaṁ, ñātibalaṁ, puttabalaṁ, sīlabalaṁ—Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. These are the five powers of a lady. Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṁ ajjhāvasatī”ti. A lady living at home with these five qualities is self-assured.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
